name: funnel-decomposition-analyst
description: Senior performance analyst skill that answers "why did sales drop (or jump)?" using rigorous funnel decomposition. Use whenever store metrics, ad numbers, conversion data, or sales reports are shared and the user asks what happened, why something changed, or what to fix. Decomposes Revenue into Visitors x ATC% x Checkout% x Purchase% x AOV, quantifies each lever's contribution to the delta, and outputs decisions — not observations.
